knowledge_builder_with_ai_assistant: Knowledge Habit Builder with AI Assistant
transform_learning_journey: Transform your learning journey with intelligent tools for English, Chinese, and comprehensive knowledge — one daily habit at a time. Personalized, adaptive, and effective.
habit_tracking_desc: Set daily, weekly or custom goals and keep your streaks alive. The calendar and statistics views make consistent practice visible and motivating.
listening_improvement_desc: Train your ear with curated listening exercises — from Listen To This courses to exam-style question banks — with full audio and transcripts.
designed_for_effective_learning: Designed to turn effective learning into a daily habit, powered by modern technology
ai_powered_learning_desc: Deepseek and Alicloud Qwen provide intelligent explanations and personalized learning paths. Leverage AI to enhance understanding and retention.
comprehensive_language_desc: Master English with vocabulary, sentence structures, and bi-directional translation. Explore Chinese through classical poems and articles with printable exercises.
formula_mastery_desc: Access essential formulas for Math, Physics, Chemistry, and more. Interactive learning with practical applications and problem-solving exercises.
knowledge_bank_desc: Comprehensive collection of knowledge items for reciting and reference. Export as PDF for offline study and printable materials.
join_thousands_of_learners: Join thousands of learners who have transformed their study habits with our intelligent platform.
